title: Re-cap CI jobs over 80% of their timeout, and set measured caps
why: A job near its timeout fails at random on a slow day.
note: Coordinator 12:10 CST. Debt jobs-over-80pct-of-cap: windows-guard and windows-guard-2 at 99%, windows-merge* at 82-94%, checks-guard at 84%, shell-macos at 83%. checks-macos-b and checks-merge-install still have the provisional 60 min cap after 29-30 green runs. A verdict change, so it needs a review.
